method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the part into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye.

sections.meaning: Set up no other god with God, or you sit condemned and abandoned; do good to parents, never say 'Ugh' to them or scold, speak gracious words, lower the wing of humility out of mercy: 'as they raised me when I was small'.
ideas: A man alone on a bare bench as the last train's lights recede
A young man gently ties his old father's shoelaces
A grown man bends low to wrap a shawl around his elderly mother
A mother bird with a lowered wing over her fledglings

sections.meaning: Give the relative his due, the destitute, the traveler; do not squander wastefully; do not chain your hand to your neck nor spread it to its full extent; he extends provision and measures it.
ideas: A traveler is handed water and bread at a door
Clean water poured into a gutter while a child holds an empty cup
A clenched fist, a wide-open spilling palm, and between them a cupped hand with a measured handful

sections.meaning: Do not kill your children for fear of poverty: we provide for them and for you; do not go near unlawful sex; do not kill the soul God has made sacred. (Nothing violent is shown: provision, a boundary, a life held gently.)
ideas: A father holding his sleeping child, a loaf on the table at dawn
A parent bird feeds chicks in a winter nest
A traveler stops short at a low fence before a crumbled cliff edge
Two cupped hands hold a small sparrow

sections.meaning: Do not go near the orphan's wealth except in the best way until he reaches his full strength; keep the covenant, it will be asked about; give full measure and weigh with the straight scale.
ideas: A man wraps coins safely away in a box for a sleeping boy
A man waits in the rain on a bridge at the agreed hour
A balance scale perfectly level with grain
Grain poured to the brim and over

sections.meaning: Do not follow what you have no knowledge of; hearing, sight and heart will be asked about; do not walk on the earth swaggering: you will not tear through the earth nor reach the mountains in height.
ideas: A line of people in thick fog each looking only at the back ahead, one has stopped to look around
A tiny strutting man before an enormous mountain

sections.meaning: The seven heavens and the earth and whoever is in them glorify him; there is nothing that does not glorify him with praise, but you do not understand their glorifying. (Never shown: the angels or any god.)
ideas: A meadow at sunrise alive with birds, dew-strung webs and bees
A night sky of stars over a still lake with fireflies

candidates.principle: Do not set up another god with God, or you will sit condemned and abandoned.

The man, the bench and the red lights are in the upper two thirds of the picture. Everything that matters is in the upper part of the frame; the lower part is plain foreground.
